body:
### UTC Date & Time

[August 06, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/aug-6-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

Devnet updates (15mins):
- Any devnet-7 bugs to report
- Beacon API PRs [#630](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/630). Can we merge both before DevNet 8? Jason Vranek / Shane Moore (SSV) / client teams
- Sparse blob pool (EIP-8070) Engine API changes mandatory for DevNet 8. Are we going ahead with this plan? There was an update on ACDT that the we might revisit this later — Bosul 
- DevNet 8 launch readiness & timeline — Stefan has the spec sheet ready; target was early August 

Other topics:

- EIP-8061 SFI decision — Increase exit/consolidation churn. CFI'd since ACDC #171, implemented and tested since DevNet-1, deferred SFI decision since May 28. Long overdue — can we SFI now? Pooja / testing team

Glamsterdam:
- First public testnet timeline - are we on track for september? With DevNet 8(the public devnet) planned for August, any blocking issues? Testing progression on track?


Hegota(1h15m):

- Non-headliner EIP submission deadline — TODAY — Window closes August 6. New PFI requests raised on the issue, set the stage for what will happen today (Its a proposal window date, its meant to introduce a topic as a contender for non-headliner in the Hegota. Not CFI/SFI decision today on these EIPs, its merely to introduce the topic and give us the time over the next months to move them from PFI to CFI. For sensitive topics, we will do our best to flag when they are to be discussed.)
-  EIP-8359 (Beacon Block Reporting Field) — [hanniabu requesting PFI](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12063) (5min)
- [EIP-8198 "Quick slots"](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8198). from Barnabe (15min) (5-10min presentation max!)
- [VOPS profiles for FOCIL eligibility](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12110) by Tomas EF (5 min)
-  EIP-8142 — kamilsa requesting PFI. [Update EIP-8142: Bib columns propagation](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12072) (5min)
- [Tapered Issuance Burn](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12081) (30min) (10min presentation max! rest is for discussions) [ [SLIDES](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1BBlYjhzVibXTigHKhrOk59PvFG9AmdVhFKsf-MTN8WM/edit?usp=sharing) ]
- EIP-7716 (Anti-correlation attestation penalties) PFI — OisinKyne updated curve addressing Potuz builder-failure concerns. Research: [Supporting decentralized staking through more anti-correlation incentives](https://ethresear.ch/t/supporting-decentralized-staking-through-more-anti-correlation-incentives/19116/18) (5min)
- [Add EIP: BLS withdrawal credential retirement](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12097) and [Balance sunset for retired BLS validators](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12099) from NC (lodestar) (5min)
- [EIP-8333: Align Checkpoint with Epoch Boundary Bloc](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8333), someone from lodestar? (2min)


Closing:
- 🐻‍❄️ Polar bear selected as a mascot!

### Call Series

All Core Devs - Consensus

Requesting PFI for EIP-8333.

EIP-8333 changes FFG checkpoint roots to anchor on the epoch boundary block, the last block before the checkpoint epoch, without changing checkpoint epochs or containers. This generalizes today's missed-first-slot behavior and aligns checkpoint roots with the boundary root used for shuffling-dependent duty checks.
